items.title: Cloud & Community Leadership (GDG, AWS Student Builder, Red Hat Ambassador)
items.organization: HKIIT / IVE / GDG / AWS / Red Hat
items.details: Focus on cloud technologies including AWS, Google Cloud, Linux, containers, and Kubernetes. Active as a Google Developer Group on Campus Leader, AWS Student Builder Group Leader, and Red Hat Student Ambassador at HKIIT. Features prominent institutional collaboration with Microsoft Hong Kong and HKIIT video promotions.
items.relevance_to_hkust_cs: Demonstrates exceptional tech leadership, strong cloud and systems engineering foundation (AWS, GCP, Linux, Kubernetes), and proven community outreach capabilities directly aligned with HKUST CS.

items.title: Higher Diploma in Cloud and Data Centre Administration (CGPA 3.91/4.0)
items.organization: Hong Kong Institute of Vocational Education (IVE) - Lee Wai Lee / HKIIT
items.details: Higher Diploma in Cloud and Data Centre Administration, Cloud Computing at Hong Kong Institute of Vocational Education (IVE) - Lee Wai Lee / HKIIT. Academic Grade: CGPA 3.91 / 4.0. Top academic performer.
items.relevance_to_hkust_cs: Exceptional academic standing (CGPA 3.91/4) proving rigorous academic excellence and readiness for HKUST Computer Science curriculum.

items.title: What Happens When an AI Agent Takes Control of a Robot? (AWS Summit HK)
items.details: Conference presentation at AWS Summit Hong Kong titled 'What Happens When an AI Agent Takes Control of a Robot?'. Explores whether an AI agent can fully operate and guide physical robot behavior, integrating cloud robotics, LLM reasoning, and real-time execution.
items.relevance_to_hkust_cs: Exemplifies innovative research at the intersection of AI Agents, Robotics, and Cloud Systems, areas of deep research focus at HKUST CS.

items.title: ProvePresent - AI Anti-Proxy Attendance Solution (HKOSCon 2026)
items.details: Conference presentation at Hong Kong Open Source Conference (HKOSCon 2026) titled '真出席 ProvePresent - AI防代打卡點名方案'. Built on Microsoft Azure core cloud infrastructure to eliminate proxy attendance in academic institutions using computer vision and verification.
items.relevance_to_hkust_cs: Demonstrates practical cloud architecture, applied AI system design, open source contribution, and high-impact software engineering skills directly relevant to HKUST CS.

items.title: Speaker at PyCon HK 2026: From Hong Kong Zero to Kubernetes Cloud-Native Learning Platform
items.details: Co-speaker alongside Cyrus Wong and Arthur Chin presenting '從港域時空到 Kubernetes: 將香港遊戲世界化身雲原生學習平台' (From Hong Kong Zero to Kubernetes: Transforming a Hong Kong Gaming World into a Cloud-Native Learning Platform). Explores how Hong Kong Zero becomes a cloud-native educational platform, turning interactive in-game quests/events into real Kubernetes cluster configuration verification tasks and streaming back execution results via WebSockets. Technical architecture leverages Python state machines, serverless event-driven pipelines, and long-running automated assessment workflows.
items.relevance_to_hkust_cs: Demonstrates advanced practical mastery of cloud-native computing, distributed systems orchestration (Kubernetes), real-time protocols (WebSockets), Python asynchronous programming, and software engineering architecture. Proves capability to deliver technical conference presentations and design scalable gamified learning platforms.
